python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

img29 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0029.png')
# Camera at (-0.5, 3.3), heading 315 (-45 deg).
# Chair 1:
# Let's find chair pixels (wood):
mask_chair = (img29[:,:,2] > 80) & (img29[:,:,2] < 150) & (img29[:,:,1] > 35) & (img29[:,:,1] < 80) & (img29[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 400) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 520)
ys_c, xs_c = np.where(mask_chair)
print('obs 29 Chair 1: bottom y =', ys_c.max(), 'center x =', xs_c.mean())

# Front leg of chair:
d_c1_29 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys_c.max() - 255.5)
print(f'obs 29 Chair 1 dist = {d_c1_29:.2f} m')
# Ray angle:
theta = np.deg2rad(315)
alpha = np.arctan((xs_c.mean() - 255.5) / 256.0)
tot_ang = theta + alpha
x_c1 = -0.5 + d_c1_29 * np.sin(tot_ang)
y_c1 = 3.3 + d_c1_29 * np.cos(tot_ang)
print(f'obs 29 Chair 1 coords: x = {x_c1:.2f}, y = {y_c1:.2f}')
"
